description: Change a to-do: its title, description, due date or priority, who it is on, or its team. `assign_to` replaces the people on it (the first is the primary owner); each is a name or a list_people id. Use it to hand a to-do to the person who owns it. Only the fields you pass change.

assign_to.description: Who it should be on, by name or id. Replaces the current set.

due_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime, or null to clear the date.

team.description: Move it to a team, by name or id; "none" makes it a personal to-do.

name: update_todo
